title: Elite Dangerous HUD Colour Editor — Elite Nexus
description: Create your Elite Dangerous HUD theme with presets, colour controls and a live preview. Save and share themes, and keep hostile contacts red with an optional graphics hook.
heading: A different colour. The same instincts.
lead: Make the HUD yours with community themes, precise colour controls and a live cockpit preview. Keep the cues you fly by: hostile red, friendly green and shield blue.
hero_alt: Elite Nexus HUD colour editor showing the Empire blue theme, colour controls and an illustrative cockpit preview with red hostile and green friendly contacts.
